author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Smooth swell fixture (Story 2.3), schema-valid and rejected at compile: coupled gamma with AM depth above 0 needs a theta reference with AM depth, and this theta reference has 0 percent. Theta reference: 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated at 6 Hz by the sine envelope, 0 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz, its AM depth a smooth swell peaking at 100 percent at the 0 degree coupling phase of the theta reference. 5 s. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
